headline: Move documents and your go bag to a higher place.
details: Put IDs, medicines, cash and phone chargers in a waterproof bag.
Keep the bag where you can grab it quickly, on an upper floor or a high shelf.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.

headline: Stay out of floodwater. It can hide open drains and sweep people and vehicles away.
details: Do not walk, swim or drive through moving or deep water.
Floodwater can carry disease and may be electrically charged.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.

headline: If water may enter your home, switch off the main power only if you can reach it safely.
details: Never touch switches or electrical items while standing in water.
Unplug appliances and move them up if there is time.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.

headline: Know your route to {center} and leave early if water rises.
details: Avoid underpasses, low bridges and fast-moving water on the way.
Go together with your household and tell a family member or neighbour where you are going.
Follow instructions from your barangay or the city disaster office.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.

headline: Charge phones and power banks while you have power.
details: Keep a flashlight and spare batteries ready.
Use flashlights instead of candles to avoid fires.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.

headline: Keep a flashlight with you and stay together with your household after dark.
details: If you must move, go as a group and keep to higher, well-lit ground.
Do not wade through floodwater in the dark.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.

headline: Secure loose items outside and stay indoors, away from windows.
details: Bring in or tie down things the wind can carry.
Stay inside the strongest part of the building until officials say it is safe.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.

headline: Follow PAGASA bulletins and your barangay announcements.
details: Check pagasa.dost.gov.ph for the latest warnings.
Keep a battery radio handy in case the internet goes down.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.

headline: Stay away from steep slopes and watch for warning signs.
details: Warning signs include new cracks in the ground, tilting trees or poles, and muddy or suddenly clear stream water.
If you see them, leave the area and tell your barangay.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.

headline: If shaking starts, drop, cover and hold on.
details: Protect your head and neck under a sturdy table.
Stay away from windows and heavy furniture that can fall.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.

headline: Expect aftershocks. Stay away from damaged buildings.
details: After the shaking stops, check for gas leaks, damage and fallen power lines.
Follow instructions from officials and PHIVOLCS.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.

headline: Keep emergency numbers handy. Call 911 if anyone is in danger.
details: Save your barangay hotline and a family contact in your phone.
Agree on a meeting place with your household.
source: Draft based on common public preparedness advice. Needs review and approval by the Batangas City disaster office (CDRRMO) before it is marked verified.
